_README: Brainwave PHENOMENOLOGY atlas. Each entry is a MEASURED literature OBSERVABLE (a number: a band in Hz, a ratio, a propagation speed, a timing) -- NOT a theoretical interpretation. The single-source / no-tuning rule applies: these are targets the 4D-DNA emergence must REPRODUCE, never values fed into it. 'status' = matched | target. Goal: drive matched_fraction to 1.0 (100% of catalogued observables reproduced). medium_efficacy_tested stays 0; reproducing an observable phenomenon is NOT a claim about its interpretation (e.g. that gamma IS consciousness).
units: hz = cycles/s ; ratio = dimensionless ; c_fraction = emitted-front speed / wave speed ; minutes ; modulation_index = dimensionless
